##### Project general facts

Azizi Lina by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with elegant facades and floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows that create a sense of harmony with the lively urban surroundings. Clean lines and efficient planning give the building a modern, practical character. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and three podium levels to nine residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units.

Residents enjoy swimming pools with a children's pool and a poolside terrace, separate fitness centres for men and women and a yoga area for a balanced routine. An indoor cinema, a game lounge, an indoor multipurpose hall, indoor and outdoor children's play areas, relaxation and social zones add variety, while a welcoming lobby, lifts, spacious parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance provide everyday comfort and peace of mind.

Residences feature thoughtful layouts, high-quality finishes and modern interiors, with large windows that bring natural light deep into the living spaces. Efficient floor plans suit professionals, couples and families who value a practical home close to work and the main transport links. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is one of the leading business and logistics hubs of Dubai, home to Jebel Ali Port, the largest port in the Middle East, and the Jebel Ali Free Zone, where thousands of international companies are based. Residential neighbourhoods, community retail, cafes, schools and clinics sit close to the business district, giving residents a practical setting close to their workplaces.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Life Pharmacy metro station is close by. Ibn Battuta Mall is a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Jumeirah Lake Towers and Dubai Parks and Resorts are close by, and Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Jebel Ali offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible entry prices in western Dubai. A large working population in the free zone and the port supports steady demand from tenants seeking homes close to their workplaces. Continued infrastructure investment around Expo City Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport underpins attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
